messages:
Mia: FYI — eu-west2 just hit GPU pool exhaustion for gen-large at 09:12 UTC. Seeing queued requests and increased lat p50->p95. We don't have an automatic spill policy for non-SLA tenants; want to discuss a degrade ladder + spillover plan. infra-bot posted the alert below.

infra-bot: [ALERT] cluster=eu-west2 pool=gen-large state=EXHAUSTED, queued=342, avg_latency_p95=740ms, triggered_at=2026-03-18T09:12:08Z :warning:

Sam: we should avoid full hard-fail for clients. Proposal: route matching by header X-RI-Tier and X-RI-Route-Hint, then a policy that does: 1) try primary model, 2) if CB trips or capacity, shift to quantized-cold variant, 3) if still constrained, soft degrade to short-context generation (truncate prompt).

Sam: config sketch (pseudo):
```
route: /v1/generate
match: header X-RI-Tier in [premium,standard,free]
policy:
  - name: primary
    model: gen-large
    cb: { errors: 25, window_s: 30 }
  - name: ladder-1
    model: gen-large-qtz
    priority: lower
  - name: ladder-2
    model: gen-medium-qtz
    truncate_prompt: true
```

Oliver: cb thresholds need to be conservative. I'd set fail_count=50 over 60s for route-level CB, but per-tenant CB can be tighter. Also add an emergency preempt action for non-SLA tenants: mark as quota-spill and shed to background pool.

Linh: how does this show up in Console? We need one-click rollback and a visual of the ladder (traffic % per step). Also an option to "lock" a tenant to not be spilled. UX asks: do we add a toggle per-route or per-tenant?

Eva: metrics we need: route_degrade_steps{route,step}, cb_trip_count{route}, spilled_tokens{tenant,route}, latency_percentiles_by_step. Can we add a dashboard card with a small sparkline + current step label? Also will want alerts on >5% traffic in step>=1 for premium customers.

Mia: agreement: per-route default ladder + opt-out per-tenant. Sam: can we make the ladder policy composable so Console can render it easily? e.g., steps as an ordered list with weights.

Sam: yes — represent as ordered array, each step has model, weight, conditions. Console can show bar chart and allow reordering. Also allow a "manual hold" on a step.

Oliver: small but important: preserve header affinity if a request arrives with X-RI-Session-Affinity. If we spill, annotate response header X-RI-Degrade-Step. That helps tracing.

Eva: +1 for X-RI-Degrade-Step. Add trace span tag too: ri.degrade.step. Update logging so we can tie quality regressions to a step.

Linh: rollout UX: when toggling a new ladder, default to dry-run for 15m with sampling 0.5% of traffic, then ramp. Need a clear CTA in console.

Mia: Ops playbook note: when cluster exhaustion alarms fire, run emergency script that flips ladder to include medium-qtz and sets non-sla tenants to spill=true. @infra-bot can we automate that?

infra-bot: ack. I can run a scripted action but need an owner + approved policy name. Suggest action: "emergency-spill-eu-west2-v1". Requires approval from oncall or release manager.

Sam: one more: telemetry sidecar should emit a delta metric for "tokens_served_by_step" so we can compute cost impact of ladder.

Oliver: implementation note: KV cache compatibility matters for small vs medium models; ensure cache key includes step id to avoid cross-model hits.

Eva: QA: create a smoke eval suite that runs sample prompts through each step and records model quality score. Hook regression alerts to that eval set.

Mia: Action items: Sam write a policy PR with the ordered-step schema + sample route; Oliver prototype CB tuning and cache-key change; Linh design Console card + quick-toggle; Eva add metrics and eval job; infra-bot to create emergency action scaffolding.

Sam: I'll open the PR in ~30m. tagging folks: @Linh @Oliver @Eva for review. :eyes:

Linh: will review UX mocks after PR.

Eva: adding cards to dashboards and alert rules next.

Oliver: will run a small canary on staging with artificial capacity pressure.

Mia: thanks everyone. We'll follow up in the PR thread.
